desc: Derive and verify the closed-form: answer = C(mn-2, k-2) × [n²·m(m²−1)/6 + m²·n(n²−1)/6] mod p; confirmed against both examples (8 and 20).
Implement the complete solution: factorials + inverse factorials up to mn (≤1e5) for C(mn-2, k-2); row/column pair-distance sums with inv(6); multiply mod p.
Test against both examples (m=2,n=2,k=2 → 8; m=1,n=4,k=3 → 20) plus brute-force verification on small grids (2×3 k=2,3; 3×3 k=4; exhaustive mn≤9) and edge cases (m=1, n=1, k=2, k=mn) — all match.
